candidates.title: User monitors and stops monitoring an issue for their own account
candidates.role: Authenticated issue viewer with monitor permission
candidates.preconditions: Issue in accessible project; user initially not monitoring; separate account available for isolation.
candidates.fixture: Enable monitoring, reload, disable monitoring, reload.

oracle.observable: Monitoring indicator and per-user state change only for the acting account; a second user remains unchanged.

novelty.rationale: Baseline assignment/status/project tests do not cover per-user monitoring state.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline assignment/status/project tests do not cover per-user monitoring state.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Second account must not inherit the first user's monitor state.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Email notification configuration may obscure the UI oracle.
candidates.uncertainty: Pinned route explicitly uses current user and monitor threshold; end-to-end notification effects are excluded.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: User monitors and stops monitoring an issue for their own account.

candidates.title: Private issue note is hidden from users below the private-note threshold
candidates.role: Reporter has add-note right; viewer lacks private-note view threshold
candidates.preconditions: Issue accessible to both; note fixture contains a unique synthetic marker; privacy enabled.
candidates.fixture: Add a private note with time-tracking value, then open as reporter and lower-privilege viewer.

oracle.observable: Authorized reporter sees note and recorded time; viewer below threshold cannot see private note or marker.

novelty.rationale: Baseline updates issue summary/status but does not cover notes, privacy visibility or time tracking.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline updates issue summary/status but does not cover notes, privacy visibility or time tracking.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Add a public note control; both users should see it.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Threshold defaults and permission settings require explicit pinning in fixture.
candidates.uncertainty: Source path uses the visible-bugnote query; the exact permission threshold and privacy persistence must be pinned in the fixture.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Private issue note is hidden from users below the private-note threshold.

candidates.title: Issue relationship rejects self-link and duplicate links
candidates.role: Can update source and destination issues
candidates.preconditions: Two accessible issues with no relationship; unique pair in isolated project.
candidates.fixture: Create a related/duplicate/dependency link, repeat it, then try linking an issue to itself.

oracle.observable: First relation is recorded once; duplicate and self-link are rejected or safely handled without duplicate rows.

novelty.rationale: Baseline links/unlinks project subprojects; issue-to-issue relationship semantics are not covered.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline links/unlinks project subprojects; issue-to-issue relationship semantics are not covered.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Try a destination issue the actor cannot view; no relationship details should leak.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Relationship type-specific constraints and duplicate handling need separate assertions.
candidates.uncertainty: Source rejects same issue and detects existing same-type relationships; exact UI outcome needs validation.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Issue relationship rejects self-link and duplicate links.

candidates.title: Issue attachment upload is persisted and rejects invalid input
candidates.role: Can update an issue and upload files
candidates.preconditions: Issue in isolated project; small synthetic text attachment with unique filename/content marker.
candidates.fixture: Upload attachment, reload issue, download it as authorized user, then attempt as unauthorized user.

oracle.observable: The issue page shows the uploaded attachment after reload; oversized/missing input produces an error and leaves no partial attachment.

novelty.rationale: Baseline issue creation/update/deletion has no attachment upload/download assertion.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline issue creation/update/deletion has no attachment upload/download assertion.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: As a user without update access, attempt upload and verify no attachment is created.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Filesystem vs database attachment mode changes storage cleanup.
candidates.uncertainty: Source validates upload input/size and checks issue access; storage configuration and exact UI error remain unverified.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Upload a small synthetic attachment, reload the issue, then submit an oversized or missing-file control.
